description: Ecommerce video ad skills for Claude Code and AI agents: plans and makes short product videos that sell on TikTok, TikTok Shop, Instagram Reels and Meta ads, with AI or real footage. Use when someone wants a viral TikTok, Reels or TikTok Shop video for a product, ecommerce ad creatives or "10 ads for my product". Hands off to product-video-hooks, tiktok-shop-video, ai-ugc-ad-video, product-photo-to-video, ad-creative-testing and ecommerce-video-edit.
